audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows contradicted the sentence printed beside them. Packet levelChart reads Warwick, Skill, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Dr. Mundo and every why tracks it; the stored sides read Warwick, Warwick, Skill, Skill, Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo — so whys[4] 'Level 6 is yours' sat under a row labelled Dr. Mundo at 4/10.
audit.why: The prose and the packet agree with each other and with a 54.6% Warwick win rate that only decays at full items; the sides are the corrupted layer, the same shift seen on aurora and camille.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 set back to the packet chart in both layers as one atomic group, ratings re-keyed. The whys then need no side rewrite.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; the ultimate is described only as 'coming up'.
audit.why: Maximum Dosage is a flat 120s and heals a percentage of MISSING health — so it gives back more the lower he is, which inverts the usual 'finish him' instinct. Infinite Duress is 110s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: 120s Maximum Dosage and its missing-health scaling written into spikes[2] and late; the 110s Infinite Duress into mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: FOUR errors. (1) Mundo's ultimate is called 'Sadism' in nine places — the current name is Maximum Dosage. (2) 'Blood Hunt makes you immune to his Infected Bonesaw slow' — Blood Hunt grants move speed and attack speed against sub-50% targets; it confers no slow immunity. (3) Warwick's Q is repeatedly called an 'execute' — it is max-health damage with no execute component. (4) The single most important interaction in this lane is absent from the entire page: Goes Where He Pleases resists the FIRST immobilising effect that hits him, so his passive eats either Primal Howl's fear or the Infinite Duress suppression.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit on all four: the passive absorbs the first immobilising effect; Blood Hunt is a speed steroid; Jaws of the Beast reads 'damage based on their maximum health'; and Infected Bonesaw is CURRENT-health damage, not max-health as the entry's late text claimed.
audit.corrected: Maximum Dosage named throughout; the slow-immunity claim replaced with the real max-health interaction (his own HP build feeds your Q and armour does not answer it); 'execute' removed; the passive's first-immobilise absorption written into spikes[1], mid, phases[4].why and wants.you[1] as the reason to spend the fear before the leap.

notes: The biggest gap on this page was an absence: Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilising effect that hits him, which means your Primal Howl fear or your Infinite Duress suppression gets absorbed — and the entry never mentioned it once. It now leads the level-6 advice. Also killed an outdated ability name used nine times ('Sadism' is now Maximum Dosage), a fabricated mechanic ('Blood Hunt makes you immune to his slow'), and repeated references to Warwick having an 'execute', which he does not. Corrected Infected Bonesaw to current-health damage; the late text had it as max-health. The packet suspect 'Land Infinite Duress' is a FALSE POSITIVE — the matcher is tripping on the leading verb.
